Text.text: The GLV Control Table application is used to upload, validate, store, display and download GL Account mapping data maintained for MOBI transactions.
• Click 'Download Template' to download the standard Excel template.
• Do not modify the column names or template structure.
• Click 'Choose Excel File' and select the completed template.
• Only .xlsx or .xls files are supported.
• The application validates all records before allowing upload.
• Company Code must contain exactly 4 digits.
• Allowed Company Codes: 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000 and 5000.
• GL Account must contain exactly 8 digits.
• Payment Type must be either Payins or Payout.
• Host Name must not exceed 20 characters.
• Only one of the following fields should contain 'X'.
- Transaction Amount
- Host MDR Amount
- Host Fee Payable
- Mobi MDR Amount
- MDR Revenue
• Duplicate GL Accounts are not allowed.
• Duplicate combinations of Company Code, Payment Type, Payment Sub Type, Host and Sequence are not allowed.
• Upload Data is enabled only after successful validation.
• Clicking Upload Data stores all valid records in the database.
• If duplicate or invalid records exist, upload will be prevented and the errors will be displayed.
• Click Display GL Data to retrieve all GL records from the database.
• The uploaded records are displayed in the table.
• Upload Data is disabled while viewing database records.
• Download GL Data is enabled only after database records are displayed.
• Clicking Download GL Data exports all displayed records into an Excel file.
• After download, the Display GL Data and Download GL Data buttons are disabled until data is displayed again.
• Valid - Record passed validation.
• Duplicate - GL Account already exists.
• Invalid Host - Host name is not maintained in the system.
• Validation errors are highlighted in the Status column.
• A - Refers to Active Record in DB.
• I - Refers to InActive Record in DB.
• Always use the downloaded template.
• Do not rename or remove any columns.
• Ensure mandatory fields are populated.
• Correct all validation errors before uploading.
• Use Display GL Data to verify records stored in the database.
